item.title: Unauthorised signs problem, 2nd November
item.description:
My neighbour for the second time this year has created a deliberate obstruction/ fly tipping on highways land immediately in front of my house. I am concerned about the hazard and risk caused yet again by her actions. No Shorrock of Waterloo Barn is fixated on causing stress/ anxiety/ nuisance. The police visited her in September, l instructed a legal firm to send a cease and desist and the harassment continues. Reference: N/A Type of query: Highways and Infrastructure Scheme/ Policy
